summary: libsoup3 HTTP library security fixes, DNF5 package manager new features, and RPC library bug fix.

changes.description: Package management service with a DBus interface
changes.note: This release adds a systemd inhibitor lock plugin (libdnf5-plugin-systemd-inhibit package) for preventing systemd from rebooting the machine while DNF5 transaction is running, IPlugin2_2 plugin interface with cleanup hooks, vendor change policy configuration format version 1.2 with additional comparators, InteractionCallbacks interface enabling libdnf5 and its plugins to ask quaetion to the users, DNF5_FORCE_COLUMNS environment variable for enforcing a width of DNF5 outputm and D-Bus daemon to validate locale strings supplied by the client.
